facts.fact: The Murang'a County government says its Afya Ke electronic medical records system had been operational in 165 health facilities, as reported 2026-10-15 (facility tiers not stated).

Murang'a County's Afya Ke electronic medical records system has been used to record and retrieve patient histories, prescriptions and lab results since 2023, in 165 health facilities per the county government; the Health CS says the ministry neither owns nor controls it and calls it a private arrangement between the county and its developers.

systems.owner: Murang'a County Government and its developers (per Health CS)

KEN.note: Story concerns a county health records system, not a county office connection.
